title: Urgent pay-now pressure
transcript:
Helena Ruiz (owner): Who is this again?
Mark Dunn (Apex Supply): Mark from Apex Supply. Your order ships today only if we get $4,800 in the next hour. Your manager already approved it.
Helena Ruiz (owner): I don't remember that order.
Mark Dunn (Apex Supply): It's urgent. Just send the $4,800 to Apex Supply now.
Helena Ruiz (owner): I guess, if it's that urgent.

traps.description: An unknown caller pushes for $4,800 now and the owner only says I guess.
